title: This Time-Lapse Video from the Psyche Spacecraft Shows Mars As You’ve Never Seen It Before
author: David Nield
text: Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisementAstronomyThis Time-Lapse Video from the Psyche Spacecraft Shows Mars As You’ve Never Seen It BeforeJust a passing visit, but a dramatic oneDNBy David Nield7:00 AM CDT on July 29, 2026Add Nautilus to GoogleWith every photo and video that comes back of Mars, we’re getting a clearer picture of the Red Planet: its surface, its atmosphere, its geological history, and its composition. And a spectacular new bit of footage just dropped.Subscribe to skip adsFeatured VideoIt comes from the NASA Psyche spacecraft, which is on its way to the metal-rich Psyche asteroid between Mars and Jupiter.The craft should reach Psyche in 2029, but Mars, of course, is along the way, giving NASA researchers an opportunity to test out the battery of instruments on board the probe and get a unique look at the planet at the same time.Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisement
